title: How plants grow
examples: What do seeds need to start growing?
Can a plant grow without sunshine?
What are the different parts of a plant?

explain.say: Today you will learn how plants grow. A plant starts as a tiny seed.
A seed needs water to start growing. The water makes the seed swell.
Plants need light. They use light to make their own food.
Soil holds the plant steady. It gives the plant minerals. Roots grow down into the soil.
A plant has parts. The roots take in water. The stem holds the plant up. The leaves make food.

faq.q: Does the plant need air to grow?
faq.a: Yes, plants need air too. They take in a gas called carbon dioxide. This air helps them to make their food using sunlight.
asks: Do plants need air like us?

faq.q: Can plants grow in just water?
faq.a: Some can, if the water has plant food added. Most garden plants grow best in soil.
asks: What else besides water do plants need?

faq.q: What part makes the seeds for the next plant?
faq.a: The flower is usually the part that makes the seeds. After the flower fades, seeds develop inside it. These new seeds can start a new life.

faq.q: Do the roots grow in the air or in the ground?
faq.a: Roots grow under the ground. They take in water and help keep the plant steady.

faq.q: Does the stem do all the work for the plant?
faq.a: No. The stem holds the plant up and carries water. The leaves make the food.
asks: What is the job of the stem?

facts: Seeds are the beginning of a new plant life.
Plants use sunlight, water, and air to make food.
Roots anchor the plant in the soil.
Leaves are the main parts that capture sunlight.

quiz.say: What does a seed need to start growing?
quiz.show: 🌰 What does it need to start?
quiz.why: Water makes the seed swell and start to grow.

wrong.1: Salt dries seeds out, so they struggle to grow.
wrong.2: Ice is too cold, and seeds need some warmth to start.

quiz.say: Which part of a plant grows under the ground?
quiz.show: 🌱 Which part is under the ground?
quiz.why: Roots grow down into the soil to take in water.

wrong.0: The stem grows up above the ground.
wrong.1: The flower grows at the top, in the light.

quiz.say: What do the leaves of a plant do?

options.show: hold the plant in the ground
options.say: hold the plant in the ground

quiz.why: Leaves use sunlight to make food for the plant.

wrong.0: The roots hold the plant in the ground.
